about: The generality gate's known debt (tools/engine/generalitycheck.ts, R-165.123, D43): each place engine code named one stage, world, seed or x position when the gate was built (2026-11-11, on release-0.9.6 @06bbd29f). Shrink-only (LAWS.md law 5): the gate fails when a counted literal no longer shows up (lower its count or delete the entry) and tools/perf/knowncheck.mjs fails when an entry or a count is added. Each moves into world data, the stage brief or a per-stage script (ENGINE-PLAN.md, the lead's review point 3; GAME-MAP A1/A2).
